boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Davidson College
boards.description: Explore the essential late-night dining spots and rituals that fuel Davidson College students, from on-campus cafes to nearby 24-hour classics.

cards.title: Late-Night Fuel at the Union
cards.subtitle: Located in the Alvarez College Union
cards.notes: Visit the third floor for smash burgers and flatbreads. It serves as a primary social hub for students seeking a hot meal during late-night study sessions.
cards.short_summary: A central campus bistro offering hot meals and grab-and-go snacks until midnight during the academic year.
cards.evidence_claim: Davis Café is located on the third floor of the Alvarez College Union and offers late-night dining options until midnight.
cards.access_notes: Open until 12:00 AM during the academic semester.

cards.title: The Campus Convenience Run
cards.subtitle: Upper level of Vail Commons
cards.notes: Stop by for pizza starting at 8 p.m. or grab fresh-baked cookies. It is the go-to spot for dorm essentials and midnight snacks.
cards.short_summary: An on-campus convenience store known for late-night pizza and a wide variety of snacks and household items.
cards.evidence_claim: The Commons Market is open late most nights and serves pizza starting at 8 p.m. every night.
cards.source_title: Battle of the On-Campus Dining Locations at Davidson College
cards.access_notes: Open late during the academic year; check current seasonal hours for exact closing.

cards.title: The 'Nummit' Study Session
cards.subtitle: Patterson Court Circle
cards.notes: Head to 'Nummit' for a student-run coffeehouse experience. It hosts trivia and live music, making it a favorite for evening social study groups.
cards.short_summary: A student-managed on-campus coffee shop and social hub located in the heart of Patterson Court.
cards.evidence_claim: Summit Coffee Outpost, often called 'Nummit', is a student-run cafe on campus that hosts events like trivia and live music.
cards.access_notes: Hours vary by semester; typically open for evening study and events.

cards.title: Main Street Scoop Run
cards.subtitle: 202 South Main Street
cards.notes: Walk across the street for a late-night waffle cone. It stays open until 10 p.m. on weekends, providing a classic dessert destination for students.
cards.short_summary: A popular ice cream shop located directly across from campus on Main Street, offering late-night treats.
cards.evidence_claim: Ben & Jerry's in Davidson is open until 10:00 PM on Fridays and Saturdays.
cards.source_title: Davidson, NC Ice Cream Shop - Ben & Jerry's
cards.access_notes: Open until 10:00 PM on Friday and Saturday.

cards.title: The 24-Hour Tradition
cards.subtitle: Huntersville Gateway Blvd
cards.notes: Drive south to Huntersville for the quintessential 24-hour diner experience. It is a reliable destination for breakfast food at any hour of the night.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour diner located a short drive from campus, serving as a staple for late-night student excursions.
cards.evidence_claim: The Waffle House location in Huntersville is open 24 hours a day.
cards.access_notes: Open 24 hours daily.

cards.title: The Late-Night Tray Run
cards.subtitle: Huntersville Gateway Blvd
cards.notes: Order a 'Cook Out Tray' with a milkshake from over 40 flavors. The drive-thru stays open until 3:30 a.m. or later, making it a student favorite.
cards.short_summary: A regional fast-food chain famous for its late-night drive-thru and extensive milkshake menu.
cards.evidence_claim: Cook Out locations typically operate until 3:30 AM or 4:30 AM, serving their full menu late into the night.
cards.access_notes: Drive-thru open until 3:30 AM (Sun-Thu) and 4:30 AM (Fri-Sat).

cards.title: Finals Week Tradition
cards.subtitle: Vail Commons
cards.notes: Join fellow students for a late-night breakfast served by faculty and staff during finals. It provides a much-needed break from exam preparation.
cards.short_summary: A beloved Davidson tradition where students gather for a late-night meal during the final exam period.
cards.evidence_claim: The Night Owl Breakfast is an annual tradition at Davidson College held during finals week.
cards.access_notes: Occurs late at night during final exam periods; check campus calendar for dates.

cards.title: Late-Night Burrito Pickup
cards.subtitle: 204 Baker Drive
cards.notes: Use the Grubhub app to order burritos or nachos for pickup. It is a convenient option for students near the Baker Sports Complex.
cards.short_summary: An on-campus Mexican grill offering customizable entrees with late-night pickup options via mobile ordering.
cards.evidence_claim: Qdoba at Davidson College offers on-campus pickup for late-night cravings through the Grubhub app.
cards.access_notes: Hours vary by semester; check the Grubhub app for current late-night availability.

cards.title: Evening Pizza at the Brickhouse
cards.subtitle: 209 Delburg Street
cards.notes: Gather for brick-oven pizza in a relaxed atmosphere. While it has a bar, the dining side is a popular evening spot for student groups and families.
cards.short_summary: A local restaurant known for its brick-oven pizza and casual dining, located just a short walk from campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Brickhouse Tavern in Davidson is open until 10:00 PM daily.
cards.access_notes: Open until 10:00 PM daily.

cards.title: Latin Street Food Run
cards.subtitle: 624 Jetton Street
cards.notes: Order authentic tacos or arepas for a late dinner. It provides a fresh, flavorful alternative to standard fast food within walking distance of campus.
cards.short_summary: A casual eatery specializing in Latin American street food, popular for evening meals near the college.
cards.evidence_claim: Sabor Latin Street Grill in Davidson is open until 9:00 PM daily.
cards.access_notes: Open until 9:00 PM daily.

boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Discover the functional study hubs and social lounges that Davidson students rely on for daily productivity and community connection beyond the standard tour stops.

cards.title: The Interim Library Hub
cards.subtitle: Chambers Building
cards.notes: Visit this historic gallery in Chambers Building, currently serving as the main collaborative study space and library service point during E.H. Little Library renovations.
cards.short_summary: The Lilly Family Gallery is the primary interim library space at Davidson College during major renovations.
cards.evidence_claim: Lilly Family Gallery is the main collaborative study space during the library renovation, housing staff, course reserves, and printers.
cards.source_title: Using The Library During Construction - Davidson College
cards.access_notes: Open 24/7 for students with CatCard access; staff available during business hours.

cards.title: The Wall Center Forum
cards.subtitle: E. Craig Wall Jr. Academic Center
cards.notes: Study on the wooden amphitheater steps or at tables in this sunlit, modern atrium that connects the college's science departments.
cards.short_summary: A massive, modern atrium in the Wall Academic Center featuring a 400-seat forum for study and social interaction.
cards.evidence_claim: The 400-seat forum of the atrium provides a space for study and social interaction at the heart of the Wall Academic Center.
cards.source_title: E. Craig Wall Jr. Academic Center Davidson College - Shepley Bulfinch
cards.access_notes: Accessible during academic building hours; typically open late for student use.

cards.title: The Quiet Sloan Nook
cards.subtitle: Sloan Music Center
cards.notes: Head to the main level of Sloan for a quieter, more secluded alternative to the main library, featuring multimedia stations and large study tables.
cards.short_summary: A specialized library in the Sloan Music Center offering a quiet environment for focused study.
cards.evidence_claim: The Music Library in Sloan Music Center includes individual and group multimedia stations and networked computers for student use.
cards.access_notes: Open during Sloan Music Center hours; check LibCal for specific library desk hours.

cards.title: The Non-Denominational Oasis
cards.subtitle: Alvarez College Union
cards.notes: Find peace in this quiet, non-denominational space on the top floor of the Union, designed for reflection and spiritual reprieve.
cards.short_summary: A dedicated quiet space in the Alvarez College Union for students of all religious and spiritual traditions.
cards.evidence_claim: The Oasis is a non-denominational space open to students of all religious traditions, located in the Alvarez College Union.
cards.source_title: Alvarez College Union Experiences Changes - Davidson College
cards.access_notes: Located on the fourth floor of the Alvarez College Union; open during building hours.

cards.title: The Lavender Lounge
cards.subtitle: Belk Residence Hall
cards.notes: Gather in this welcoming LGBTQIA+ community space on the lower level of Belk Hall, featuring a library of over 300 films and books.
cards.short_summary: A community lounge for LGBTQIA+ students and allies located in the lower level of Belk Hall.
cards.evidence_claim: The Lavender Lounge is located on the lower level of Belk Residence Hall and serves as a welcoming environment for LGBTQIA+ students.
cards.access_notes: Open to all members of the Davidson community throughout the academic year.

cards.title: Chambers Student Lounge
cards.subtitle: Chambers Building
cards.notes: Utilize this dedicated student lounge within the Chambers Building for quick study sessions between classes in the college's primary academic hall.
cards.short_summary: A student-focused lounge located within the historic Chambers Building.
cards.evidence_claim: The Hines Family Student Lounge is listed as a facility within the Chambers Building.
cards.access_notes: Accessible during Chambers Building academic hours.

cards.title: Diversity & Inclusion Lounge
cards.subtitle: Alvarez College Union
cards.notes: Relax in this community-building space in the Union, designed for organic conversation, games, and refreshments among diverse student groups.
cards.short_summary: A student-centered lounge within the Center for Student Diversity and Inclusion in the Alvarez Union.
cards.evidence_claim: The CSDI in the Alvarez College Union has a student-centered lounge that strives to be a community building space.
cards.source_title: Center for Student Diversity and Inclusion - Davidson College
cards.access_notes: Located within the CSDI suite in the Alvarez College Union; open during building hours.

cards.title: The Dome Auditorium
cards.subtitle: Chambers Building
cards.notes: Look up at the historic brick dome in this top-floor auditorium, recently upgraded for high-end acoustics and used for student club meetings and screenings.
cards.short_summary: A 115-seat presentation space located under the dome of the Chambers Building.
cards.evidence_claim: Hance Auditorium is a 115-seat multi-purpose presentation space located on the top floor, under the dome of the Chambers Building.
cards.source_title: Davidson College Hance Auditorium - Thorburn Associates
cards.access_notes: Used for classes and scheduled student organization meetings; accessible via the top floor of Chambers.

cards.title: The Silent Study Retreat
cards.subtitle: Tomlinson Hall
cards.notes: Find the absolute quiet of the former library basement in this 24-hour conference room, now designated as a primary silent study zone.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour silent study space located in the basement of Tomlinson Hall.
cards.evidence_claim: The silent study once relegated to the basement of the old library can now be found in the Tomlinson conference room.
cards.source_title: How to Use the College Library During Renovations - Davidson College
cards.access_notes: Open 24 hours for students; CatCard access required outside of business hours.

cards.title: The Union Living Room
cards.subtitle: Alvarez College Union
cards.notes: Relax in this comfortable lounge located just inside the terrace entrance of the Knobloch Campus Center, perfect for casual meetings.
cards.short_summary: A central lounge and gathering space located within the Alvarez College Union.
cards.evidence_claim: Johnston Living Room is located just inside the terrace entrance to the Knobloch Campus Center.
cards.access_notes: Open during Alvarez College Union building hours.

boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Explore Davidson College without spending a dime. From lakeside relaxation to contemporary art galleries and serene nature trails, these campus spots offer free social and recreational opportunities for students and visitors alike.

cards.title: Contemporary Art at the VAC
cards.subtitle: Belk Visual Arts Center
cards.notes: Browse rotating contemporary exhibitions and the permanent collection. Admission is free for all visitors during standard gallery hours.
cards.short_summary: Free contemporary art galleries located within the Belk Visual Arts Center.
cards.evidence_claim: All programs of the Van Every/Smith Galleries are free and open to the public. Hours are M-F 10-5 and weekends 12-4.
cards.access_notes: Open Monday-Friday 10 a.m. to 5 p.m. (Wednesday until 7 p.m.) and weekends 12 p.m. to 4 p.m.

cards.title: Waterfront Relaxation
cards.subtitle: Lake Norman
cards.notes: Access 110 acres of waterfront property for swimming, sunbathing, and beach volleyball. Bring your CatCard for entry to this private college facility.
cards.short_summary: A 110-acre private recreational facility on Lake Norman for the Davidson community.
cards.evidence_claim: Lake Campus provides Davidson students with the unique opportunity to be involved in a variety of water activities including a waterfront beach and swim area.
cards.access_notes: Open 7 a.m. to 7 p.m. daily. Requires a valid College ID or Alumni Pass for entry.

cards.title: Hike the Nature Trails
cards.subtitle: Adjacent to Main Campus
cards.notes: Walk or jog through 200 acres of protected forest. The preserve features 5K and 8K trail loops accessible from the north and south campus entrances.
cards.short_summary: A 200-acre forested preserve with extensive trails for hiking, running, and bird watching.
cards.evidence_claim: The preserve offers 5K and 8K trails for jogging, walking, and bird watching, as well as large tracts of habitat for ecological studies.
cards.access_notes: Publicly accessible trails; open dawn to dusk daily.

cards.title: Self-Guided Art Walk
cards.subtitle: Across Campus
cards.notes: Tour over 20 major outdoor sculptures by world-renowned artists. Use the Bloomberg Connects app for free audio commentary at each stop.
cards.short_summary: An outdoor collection of world-class sculptures integrated into the college landscape.
cards.evidence_claim: The Campus Sculpture Program... exposes the Davidson community to a diverse range of sculptural works... interpreted through our digital guide on Bloomberg Connects.
cards.source_title: Art on Campus - Davidson College Art Galleries
cards.access_notes: Outdoor sculptures are accessible 24/7; the digital guide is free to download.

cards.title: Billiards at the Union
cards.subtitle: Alvarez College Union
cards.notes: Challenge friends to a game of pool on the main floor of the student union. This social hub is a staple for casual student hangouts.
cards.short_summary: A student-focused game room featuring pool tables inside the Alvarez College Union.
cards.evidence_claim: The college union staple pool tables are located on the main floor. The game room is named in memory of Thad Jones '63.
cards.access_notes: Open during regular student union hours; typically accessible until midnight or 1 a.m.

cards.title: Meditative Labyrinth Walk
cards.subtitle: Hobart Park
cards.notes: Find peace at this red-brick labyrinth tucked under the trees. It is lit at night, making it a quiet spot for reflection at any hour.
cards.short_summary: A peaceful outdoor brick labyrinth and garden designed for walking meditation.
cards.evidence_claim: The red-brick labyrinth and peace garden provide a great outdoor spot for walking meditation... The labyrinth is lit at night, making it accessible any time.
cards.access_notes: Located between Faculty Drive and Baker Drive; accessible 24/7 and lit at night.

cards.title: Cheer on the Wildcats
cards.subtitle: Various Campus Venues
cards.notes: Attend home games for sports like baseball, tennis, and volleyball for free. Most regular-season events are open to the public without a ticket.
cards.short_summary: Free admission to many NCAA Division I home games for the Davidson community and public.
cards.evidence_claim: All other sports' regular season, home games are free to the public with general admission seating.
cards.source_title: Student Ticket Home - Davidson College Athletics
cards.access_notes: Check the official athletics calendar for game times; no ticket required for non-revenue sports.

cards.title: Quiet Rest at Lingle Chapel
cards.subtitle: Main St. & Concord Rd.
cards.notes: Visit this serene worship space for prayer or quiet meditation. It remains open to the public 24/7, offering a peaceful retreat from campus life.
cards.short_summary: A historic chapel open 24/7 for public prayer, meditation, and quiet reflection.
cards.evidence_claim: Lingle Chapel is open to the public 24/7 for prayer, meditation, and quiet rest.
cards.access_notes: Open 24 hours a day, 7 days a week to the general public.

cards.title: Collaborative Study Space
cards.subtitle: E. Craig Wall Jr. Academic Center
cards.notes: Gather in the open forum or student common areas for group projects or casual conversation. This modern facility is designed for campus-wide collaboration.
cards.short_summary: A central gathering and study space featuring an open forum for the campus community.
cards.evidence_claim: Student common areas and an open forum space provide a gathering place for the campus community and encourages collaboration.
cards.access_notes: Open during academic building hours; typically accessible to students late into the evening.

cards.title: Classical Radio Hub
cards.subtitle: 423 North Main Street
cards.notes: Visit the home of WDAV 89.9, one of the nation's top classical public radio stations. The building is a unique campus resource for cultural arts programming.
cards.short_summary: The purpose-built facility for Davidson's award-winning classical public radio station.
cards.evidence_claim: The Newell Building is home to WDAV 89.9, a public radio service of Davidson College... providing classical music and cultural arts programming.
cards.access_notes: Public areas are accessible during business hours; check for special events or open house tours.

boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: With the E.H. Little Library undergoing major renovations, Davidson students have pivoted to a mix of historic halls, modern science hubs, and interim library spaces across campus.

cards.title: The Interim Library Hub
cards.subtitle: Alvarez College Union
cards.notes: Visit the main collaborative study space during library renovations. It features desktop computers, a laptop kiosk, and furniture repurposed from E.H. Little Library.
cards.short_summary: The primary collaborative study space and interim library location during the E.H. Little Library renovation.
cards.evidence_claim: Lilly Family Gallery is the main collaborative study space during the library renovation, equipped with desktop computers, a laptop kiosk, and library staff.
cards.source_title: Using The Library During Construction - Davidson College
cards.access_notes: Open 24/7 for students during the academic year; CatCard required for after-hours entry.

cards.title: The Silent Study Sanctuary
cards.subtitle: Tomlinson Hall
cards.notes: Head to the basement for the campus's primary silent study area. It features traditional study carrels for focused, distraction-free work sessions.
cards.short_summary: A dedicated silent study space located in the basement of Tomlinson Hall, featuring traditional library carrels.
cards.evidence_claim: The Tomlinson Hall Basement Conference Room is the primary silent study space during the interim period, featuring reused study carrels from E.H. Little Library.
cards.source_title: Using The Library During Construction - Davidson College
cards.access_notes: Open 24/7; CatCard access only.

cards.title: The Collaborative Atrium
cards.subtitle: E. Craig Wall Jr. Academic Center
cards.notes: Utilize the 400-seat forum and common areas for group projects. The open-concept design encourages interaction between science disciplines.
cards.short_summary: A modern, high-ceilinged atrium and forum space designed for collaborative study and social interaction.
cards.evidence_claim: The 400-seat forum of the atrium provides a space for study and social interaction, with gathering spaces sprinkled along circulation paths.
cards.source_title: E. Craig Wall Jr. Academic Center - Davidson College
cards.access_notes: Accessible during building hours; typically open late for students.

cards.title: The Cozy Music Nook
cards.subtitle: Sloan Music Center 101
cards.notes: Find a quiet spot among the scores and recordings. This space offers three group study alcoves that can be reserved for evening sessions.
cards.short_summary: A specialized library in the Sloan Music Center offering a quiet environment and reservable group study alcoves.
cards.evidence_claim: The Music Library serves as the primary quiet study space during construction and features three group study alcoves reservable after 5 p.m.
cards.source_title: Using The Library During Construction - Davidson College
cards.access_notes: Open 7:00 a.m. to 11:59 p.m. daily.

cards.title: The Historic Study Hall
cards.subtitle: Chambers Building, Second Floor
cards.notes: Study in one of the most iconic buildings on campus. This room serves as a library teaching space but is open for group study when not in use.
cards.short_summary: A historic room in the Chambers Building that functions as a flexible study space for students.
cards.evidence_claim: When not in use for library sessions, students are welcome to use the Baxter Davidson Room for group study.
cards.source_title: Using The Library During Construction - Davidson College
cards.access_notes: Open 5:00 p.m. to 6:00 a.m. for student study use.

cards.title: The 24/7 Group Room
cards.subtitle: Chambers Building
cards.notes: Reserve this classroom for late-night group projects. It is one of the designated 24-hour reservable spaces during the library renovation.
cards.short_summary: A designated classroom in the Chambers Building available for 24/7 group study reservations.
cards.evidence_claim: Chambers classrooms 2130 and 2164 are available to reserve 24/7 for group study.
cards.source_title: Using The Library During Construction - Davidson College
cards.access_notes: Available 24/7 via reservation system.

cards.title: The Drop-In Tech Spot
cards.subtitle: Chambers Building, Third Floor
cards.notes: Use the desktop computers for intensive tasks or find a spot for group study. This lab operates on a first-come, first-served basis.
cards.short_summary: A third-floor computer lab in Chambers providing drop-in access to technology and group study space.
cards.evidence_claim: The computer lab in Classroom 3130 is available for drop-in computer use and group study on a first-come, first-served basis.
cards.source_title: Using The Library During Construction - Davidson College
cards.access_notes: First-come, first-served; building access hours apply.

cards.title: The Creative Studio
cards.subtitle: Katherine and Tom Belk Visual Arts Center
cards.notes: Work in a space surrounded by contemporary art. Students in VAC classes have extended late-night access to these specialized studio facilities.
cards.short_summary: Specialized studio and study spaces for art students, featuring a digital art lab and Visual Resource Center.
cards.evidence_claim: Students enrolled in classes in the Visual Arts Center have CatCard access to facilities from 6 a.m. to 2 a.m. daily.
cards.access_notes: CatCard access 6:00 a.m. to 2:00 a.m. for enrolled students.

cards.title: The Lower Level Retreat
cards.subtitle: Sloan Music Center
cards.notes: Head to the lower level for a mix of vending areas and study tables. It's a practical spot for a quick study session between practice rounds.
cards.short_summary: A student lounge in the lower level of the music center equipped with study tables and vending machines.
cards.evidence_claim: The lower level of Sloan Music Center includes a student lounge with vending areas, lounge chairs, and study tables.
cards.access_notes: Accessible during building hours.

cards.title: The Science Hub
cards.subtitle: Baker-Watt Science Complex
cards.notes: Find a quiet corner in this 45,000-square-foot facility. It houses biology and psychology labs along with general classrooms used for study.
cards.short_summary: A major academic building in the science complex offering classrooms and support spaces for student use.
cards.evidence_claim: The Watson Life Sciences Building houses general classrooms, laboratories, and support space for biology and psychology.
cards.access_notes: Building access hours apply; typically open for student use during the day.

boards.title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
boards.description: Explore the essential streets and corridors immediately surrounding Davidson College, where historic charm meets student life in the heart of North Carolina.

cards.title: The College Gateway
cards.subtitle: Main Street Corridor
cards.notes: Walk the brick-lined sidewalks where the campus meets the town. This block houses the college's main entrance and the historic Grey House admission center.
cards.short_summary: The primary interface between Davidson College and the town's historic commercial district.
cards.evidence_claim: The college's main entrance is located at 405 North Main Street in Davidson, N.C., adjacent to the Grey House admission office.
cards.source_title: Grey House and Harding House - Davidson College
cards.access_notes: Publicly accessible sidewalk and thoroughfare.

cards.title: Restaurant Row
cards.subtitle: Main Street Corridor
cards.notes: Visit this vibrant stretch known for nationally acclaimed dining and local boutiques. It serves as the social heart for students and residents alike.
cards.short_summary: A bustling commercial block south of the college known for its dense concentration of restaurants.
cards.evidence_claim: South Main Street is referred to as 'restaurant row' and is lined with numerous options and nationally acclaimed dining.
cards.access_notes: Public street with various business hours.

cards.title: The Academic Link
cards.subtitle: Concord Road Corridor
cards.notes: Follow this road to reach the Sloan Music Center and the Baker Sports Complex. It connects the central campus to major athletic and arts facilities.
cards.short_summary: A key corridor on the eastern edge of campus housing music and athletic venues.
cards.evidence_claim: The Sloan Music Center is located at 323 Concord Road, near the heart of campus and east of the Baker-Watt Science Complex.
cards.access_notes: Public road; facility hours vary by event.

cards.title: The Town Gateway
cards.subtitle: Griffith Street Corridor
cards.notes: Enter Davidson via this principal gateway. This block connects the I-77 interchange to the historic village center and the college's north side.
cards.short_summary: The primary western entrance to the town and college from the interstate.
cards.evidence_claim: Griffith Street is the principal gateway to the Town of Davidson and Davidson College, connecting to the village center.
cards.source_title: Griffith Street Corridor Plan - Davidson, NC
cards.access_notes: Major public thoroughfare.

cards.title: Historic Rail District
cards.subtitle: Depot Street Corridor
cards.notes: Explore the area around the old train depot. It offers free all-day parking for visitors and is home to the Davidson Village Inn.
cards.short_summary: A historic street reflecting Davidson's railroad heritage, now featuring lodging and parking.
cards.evidence_claim: The Davidson Village Inn is located at 117 Depot Street, and the nearby church lot offers free all-day parking.
cards.access_notes: Public street; parking lot available Monday-Friday.

cards.title: The Administrative Circle
cards.subtitle: Jackson Court Corridor
cards.notes: Walk through Jackson Court, a semi-circle of nine historic houses. Originally fraternity lodges, they now house various college administrative offices.
cards.short_summary: A unique semi-circular street of historic homes used for college services.
cards.evidence_claim: Jackson Court is comprised of nine small houses in a semi-circle on the southeast side of campus, housing offices like Human Resources.
cards.access_notes: Publicly accessible court; office hours typically 8:30 AM - 5:00 PM.

cards.title: Residential Student Orbit
cards.subtitle: Catawba Avenue Corridor
cards.notes: Stroll down this quiet residential street just blocks from campus. It is a popular area for off-campus student housing and local rentals.
cards.short_summary: A residential corridor providing housing options within walking distance of the college.
cards.evidence_claim: Catawba Avenue features various rental properties and townhomes popular with the Davidson community.
cards.access_notes: Public residential street.

cards.title: The Greenway Connection
cards.subtitle: Lorimer Road Corridor
cards.notes: Access local greenways from this street. It connects the campus area to Davidson's network of walking and biking trails.
cards.short_summary: A street providing access to the town's recreational trail system.
cards.evidence_claim: Greenways connect neighborhoods to Main Street and Davidson College, with access points near Lorimer Road.
cards.source_title: Discover Downtown Davidson NC Shops and Cafes
cards.access_notes: Public street and trail access.

cards.title: The Parkside Corridor
cards.subtitle: Beaty Street Corridor
cards.notes: Walk toward Roosevelt Wilson Park along this corridor. It serves as a transition between the commercial downtown and residential areas.
cards.short_summary: A corridor linking the downtown core to local parks and residential neighborhoods.
cards.evidence_claim: Beaty Street is part of the Griffith Street Corridor Plan, connecting to local parks and residential districts.
cards.source_title: Griffith Street Corridor Plan - Davidson, NC
cards.access_notes: Public street.

cards.title: The Social District Extension
cards.subtitle: Watson Street Corridor
cards.notes: Explore this block recently added to the town's social district. It connects the Main Street shops to the emerging Sadler Square area.
cards.short_summary: A street bridging the historic downtown with new commercial developments.
cards.evidence_claim: The Main Street social district was expanded to include Watson Street and reach toward Sadler Square.
cards.source_title: Town to expand main street social district - Davidsonian
cards.access_notes: Public street; social district rules apply for alcohol consumption.

boards.title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
boards.description: Explore the unique rituals and long-standing customs that define the Wildcat experience at Davidson College.

cards.title: The Freshman Cake Race
cards.subtitle: A 1.7-mile sprint for homemade prizes
cards.notes: Run a 1.7-mile course to win a homemade cake baked by faculty and town residents. This tradition began in 1930 as a way for the track coach to scout new talent.
cards.short_summary: First-year students compete in a campus race where the prizes are elaborate, locally baked cakes.
cards.evidence_claim: The Freshman Cake Race started in 1930 and involves first-year students running a 1.3 to 1.7 mile race to win cakes donated by the community.
cards.source_title: Davidson Cake Race a Sweet College Tradition Since 1930
cards.access_notes: Held annually on the Wednesday of the first week of classes at the Wildcat statue.

cards.title: Honor Code Signing Ceremony
cards.subtitle: A formal pledge of academic integrity
cards.notes: Sign the official Honor Code book during orientation to join a community of trust. This pledge enables unproctored exams and a culture of mutual respect.
cards.short_summary: A foundational ceremony where every new student formally pledges to uphold the college's strict Honor Code.
cards.evidence_claim: The Honor Code signing ceremony is a distinctive moment for first-year students, connecting them to the college's history of trust and responsibility.
cards.access_notes: Takes place in the Chambers Building during new student orientation.

cards.title: Flickerball
cards.subtitle: The unique sport of Davidson
cards.notes: Compete in this hybrid of football and basketball, unique to Davidson since 1951. Freshmen residence halls field teams for intense, high-spirited tournaments.
cards.short_summary: A unique intramural sport created at Davidson as a safer alternative to touch football.
cards.evidence_claim: Flickerball originated in 1951 at Davidson College and is a sport unique to the institution, played in freshman and open leagues.
cards.access_notes: Games are typically held on the intramural fields during the fall semester.

cards.title: Phi and Eu Balcony Debates
cards.subtitle: Quadrennial political shouting matches
cards.notes: Watch student political groups debate from the balconies of Philanthropic and Eumenean Halls. This quadrennial tradition coincides with U.S. presidential elections.
cards.short_summary: Lively political debates held between the historic halls of the college's oldest literary societies.
cards.evidence_claim: During presidential election years, college democrats and republicans debate from the balconies of Eu and Phi Halls, a tradition dating back to the 1800s.
cards.access_notes: Occurs every four years during the fall of a U.S. presidential election year on the Historic Quad.

cards.title: The Midnight Scream
cards.subtitle: A collective release of exam stress
cards.notes: Join the campus-wide shout at midnight on the night before final exams begin. It is a brief, loud moment of solidarity to release academic pressure.
cards.short_summary: A tradition where students gather to scream collectively at midnight to relieve stress before finals.
cards.evidence_claim: The Midnight Scream happens before the first day of exams as students across campus come together to release stress.
cards.access_notes: Occurs at midnight on the night of Reading Day before final exams.

cards.title: Self-Scheduled Exams
cards.subtitle: The ultimate test of the Honor Code
cards.notes: Pick up your exam and take it at a time and location of your choice during finals week. This practice relies entirely on the student's commitment to the Honor Code.
cards.short_summary: A unique academic practice where students choose when and where to take their final examinations.
cards.evidence_claim: The Honor Code allows Davidson to administer final exams in a way that gives students flexibility through self-scheduling.
cards.access_notes: Available to students during the final exam period each semester.

cards.title: Christmas Vespers
cards.subtitle: A candlelight service of lessons and carols
cards.notes: Attend the annual candlelight service featuring the Davidson College Choirs and scripture readings. It is a peaceful community event held in the campus church.
cards.short_summary: A traditional holiday service featuring choral music and candlelight in the college's historic church.
cards.evidence_claim: Christmas Vespers is an annual candlelight worship service featuring choral music and scripture readings at the Davidson College Presbyterian Church.
cards.access_notes: Held annually in early December; free and open to the public.

cards.title: The Old Well Legend
cards.subtitle: A superstition for campus sweethearts
cards.notes: Visit the historic well on the quad, where legend says a kiss ensures a future marriage. It remains one of the most photographed and storied spots on campus.
cards.short_summary: A campus landmark associated with a romantic superstition about future marriage.
cards.evidence_claim: Legend has it that young couples who share a kiss by the Old Well will be granted luck in love and eventually marry.
cards.access_notes: Located on the Historic Quad and accessible 24/7.

cards.title: Spring Convocation
cards.subtitle: A celebration of student achievement
cards.notes: Gather in the Duke Family Performance Hall to recognize academic and leadership awards. Seniors wear their caps and gowns for the first time in this 'dress rehearsal'.
cards.short_summary: An annual ceremony honoring student excellence where seniors debut their graduation regalia.
cards.evidence_claim: Spring Convocation is an annual ceremony that recognizes student achievement and leadership, with seniors attending in caps and gowns.
cards.source_title: Many Bright Lights: Davidson College Celebrates Spring Convocation
cards.access_notes: Held annually in April at the Duke Family Performance Hall.

cards.title: Senior Mug Night
cards.subtitle: A commemorative gift for graduating Wildcats
cards.notes: Receive a personalized Davidson mug as a gift from the Alumni Association. This event marks the transition from student to alumnus for the graduating class.
cards.short_summary: A celebratory event where seniors receive a commemorative mug to mark their upcoming graduation.
cards.evidence_claim: Senior Celebration & Mug Night is an event hosted by Alumni and Family Engagement to honor the graduating class.
cards.access_notes: Typically held in the spring for the graduating senior class.

boards.title: Your First Weekend at Davidson College, Shared as Cards
boards.description: A curated sequence of essential Davidson College experiences for a new student's first weekend, from historic traditions to local favorites.

cards.title: Kick Off at the Opening Session
cards.subtitle: Friday Evening Orientation Kickoff
cards.notes: Join your new Wildcat family at the Baker Sports Complex for the official opening session that marks the start of your Davidson journey.
cards.short_summary: The official opening session for new students and families at Baker Sports Complex.
cards.evidence_claim: New students and their families kick off Orientation with an Opening Session at the Baker Sports Complex.
cards.access_notes: Mandatory for new students; typically held on the first Friday evening of orientation.

cards.title: Relax by Lake Norman
cards.subtitle: Saturday Afternoon Waterfront Social
cards.notes: Take the shuttle to the 110-acre Lake Campus for swimming, volleyball, and kayaking. It is a signature spot for orientation socials.
cards.short_summary: A 110-acre waterfront property on Lake Norman for student recreation and orientation events.
cards.evidence_claim: The Lake Campus hosts orientation socials and offers free equipment checkout for kayaks and paddleboards for students.
cards.access_notes: Open 7 a.m. – 7 p.m. daily; CatCard required for entry. Alcohol-free facility.

cards.title: The Welcome Back Party
cards.subtitle: Saturday Night Social Hub
cards.notes: Head to 'The Union' for the first major social event of the year. Expect themed decor, music, and a chance to meet the whole campus.
cards.short_summary: The first major student-led programming event of the year held at the Alvarez College Union.
cards.evidence_claim: The Welcome Back Party is the first Union Board event of the year, held at the Alvarez College Union.
cards.source_title: Spotlight on the Union Board - Davidson College
cards.access_notes: Open to all students; typically held on the first or second weekend of the fall semester.

cards.title: Coffee at 'Nummit'
cards.subtitle: Sunday Morning Study Spot
cards.notes: Known by students as 'Nummit,' this on-campus coffee shop is the heart of Patterson Court. Perfect for a low-key Sunday morning.
cards.short_summary: The student-run on-campus location of Summit Coffee, a central hub for student life.
cards.evidence_claim: Summit Outpost, coined 'nummit' by students, is the on-campus option for coffee and a hub for student events.
cards.access_notes: Students can use Dining Dollars here; check for late-night weekend hours.

cards.title: Gear Up on Main Street
cards.subtitle: Sunday Afternoon Shopping
cards.notes: Walk to Main Street to grab your Wildcat gear and textbooks. It's the official campus bookstore located in the heart of town.
cards.short_summary: The official college bookstore and merchandise provider located on Main Street.
cards.evidence_claim: The Davidson College Store is located at 137 N. Main St. and serves as the campus bookstore.
cards.access_notes: Located off-campus on Main Street; open daily with varying weekend hours.

cards.title: The Freshman Cake Race
cards.subtitle: Wednesday Tradition Preview
cards.notes: While the race is Wednesday, use the weekend to scout the route starting at the Wildcat Statue. It's a 95-year-old tradition.
cards.short_summary: A historic 1.3 to 1.7 mile race for first-year students where winners receive handmade cakes.
cards.evidence_claim: The Freshman Cake Race is held the Wednesday of the first week of classes, starting at the Wildcat statue.
cards.source_title: Davidson Cake Race a Sweet College Tradition Since 1930
cards.access_notes: Participation is for first-year students; the community gathers to watch and provide cakes.

cards.title: Explore the Galleries
cards.subtitle: Sunday Cultural Walk
cards.notes: Visit the Van Every/Smith Galleries to see rotating exhibitions. It's a quiet, inspiring space to visit before classes begin.
cards.short_summary: The Katherine and Tom Belk Visual Arts Center houses galleries and art studios.
cards.evidence_claim: The Van Every/Smith Galleries are free and open to the public, with weekend hours from 12-4 p.m.
cards.access_notes: Galleries are open weekends 12-4 p.m.; free admission.

cards.title: Find Your Study Nook
cards.subtitle: Sunday Evening Prep
cards.notes: Get ahead by finding your favorite spot in the library. During renovations, the Lilly Gallery serves as a main collaborative space.
cards.short_summary: The central academic library of Davidson College, currently undergoing major renovations.
cards.evidence_claim: The library is open to students 24/7 during the academic year; Lilly Gallery is a main collaborative study space during renovation.
cards.access_notes: 24/7 access for students with CatCard during the academic year.

cards.title: Stroll Through Downtown
cards.subtitle: The Town-Gown Connection
cards.notes: Explore the 'Hallmark movie' charm of Main Street. It's highly walkable and filled with local cafes and independent boutiques.
cards.short_summary: The historic and walkable downtown corridor adjacent to the Davidson College campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Davidson's historic Main Street is known for its walkability, red brick streets, and locally owned shops.
cards.source_title: Day in the Life: What Does a Weekend Look Like at Davidson College?
cards.access_notes: Public street; most shops are open during standard daytime and weekend hours.

cards.title: First Meal at 'Commons'
cards.subtitle: The Primary Dining Hall
cards.notes: Experience your first meal at the main dining hall. It's where the community gathers for fresh, sustainable food options.
cards.short_summary: The primary dining facility for Davidson College students, focusing on variety and nutrition.
cards.evidence_claim: First-year students are required to have a meal plan, with Vail Commons serving as a primary dining location.
cards.access_notes: Requires meal plan or CatCard for entry; check daily hours for weekend service.
